description: Per-member and per–service-account Cursor cost and usage. Members from /teams/members; service accounts from usage events (service_account_id).

options.content:
- **Use case:** Cost and usage for one team member or service account (e.g. cloud agents).
- **Data source:** Cursor plugin — `_tool_cursor_usage_events`, `_tool_cursor_user_spend`, `_tool_cursor_members`.
- **Related:** [Cursor Usage & Cost](/d/cursor_usage); [Cursor Enterprise AI Code & Insights](/d/cursor_enterprise); [Cursor BugBot Review Analytics](/d/cursor_bugbot).

panels.description: Total charged amount for billable usage events for the selected member in the selected time range (event_time).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charged_cents), 0) / 100 AS "Charged Amount"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'

panels.title: Charged Amount

panels.description: On-demand (Usage-based) charged amount for the selected member in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Usage-based' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) / 100 AS "On-Demand Amount"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'

panels.title: On-Demand Amount

panels.description: Average charged cost per usage event for the selected member in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charged_cents) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) / 100 AS "Avg Cost / Event"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'

panels.title: Avg Cost / Event

panels.description: Days since the selected member's most recent usage event; green < 2d, yellow 2-6d, red >= 7d.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, MAX(event_time), UTC_TIMESTAMP()), 9999) AS "Days Since Latest Event"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'

panels.title: Data Freshness

panels.description: Current billing-cycle fast premium requests for the selected member from /teams/spend, compared to a 500-request allocation. Green < 80%, yellow 80-99%, red >= 100%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN '${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(MAX(fast_premium_requests), 0) END AS "Requests"
FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND email = '${member}'
  AND billing_cycle_start = (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
    WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
      AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
      AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))

panels.title: Premium Requests (of 500)

panels.description: Current billing-cycle on-demand spend for the selected member from /teams/spend (not filtered by dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN '${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' THEN (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Usage-based' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) / 100
  FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
  WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
    AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'
    AND event_time >= (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
    WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
      AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
      AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))
) ELSE (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend_cents), 0) / 100
  FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
  WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
    AND email = '${member}'
    AND billing_cycle_start = (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
    WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
      AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
      AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))
) END AS "On-Demand Amount"

panels.title: On-Demand Amount

panels.description: Count of usage events for the selected member since the current billing cycle start (not filtered by dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Used Events"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'
  AND event_time >= (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
    WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
      AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
      AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))

panels.title: Used Events

panels.description: Sum of input, output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens for the selected member since the current billing cycle start (not filtered by dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens), 0) AS "Used Tokens"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'
  AND event_time >= (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
    WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
      AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
      AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))

panels.title: Used Tokens

panels.description: Total charged usage for the selected member or service account since the current billing cycle start (sum of charged_cents on usage events). Compare to Cursor dashboard figures.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charged_cents), 0) / 100 AS "Charged Since Cycle Start"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'
  AND event_time >= (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend
    WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
      AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
      AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))

panels.title: Charged Since Cycle Start

panels.description: Daily charged spend for the selected member, split by billing kind: on-demand (Usage-based) vs included (Included in Business).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(event_time) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Usage-based' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END) / 100 AS "On-Demand",
  SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Included in Business' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END) / 100 AS "Included"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'
GROUP BY DATE(event_time)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily Spend

panels.description: Average cost per event, total charged, event count, tokens, and share of total events by model for the selected member.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model AS "Model",
  SUM(total_cents) / COUNT(*) / 100 AS "Avg Cost",
  SUM(charged_cents) / 100 AS "Charged",
  COUNT(*) AS "Events",
  SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens) AS "Tokens",
  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "Usage %"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY SUM(charged_cents) DESC

panels.title: Cost by Model

panels.description: Total charged spend by billing kind for the selected member in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kind AS "Kind",
  SUM(charged_cents) / 100 AS "Charged"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY SUM(charged_cents) DESC

panels.title: Cost by Kind

panels.description: Recent chat sessions for the selected member, most recent first. Cursor usage events do not include a chat title, so Chat shows the session's latest model plus its last-event timestamp. Events with no conversation_id are grouped into a single (no session) row.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN t.session_id = '' THEN '(no session)'
    ELSE CONCAT(t.latest_model, ' · ', DATE_FORMAT(t.last_event, '%b %e, %Y %H:%i'))
  END AS "Chat",
  t.charged_cents / 100 AS "Charged",
  t.events AS "Events",
  t.tokens AS "Tokens",
  t.last_event AS "Last Event"
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(conversation_id), ''), '') AS session_id,
    SUM(charged_cents) AS charged_cents,
    COUNT(*) AS events,
    SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens) AS tokens,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_event,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(model ORDER BY event_time DESC SEPARATOR '||'), '||', 1) AS latest_model
  FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
    AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(conversation_id), ''), '')
) t
ORDER BY t.last_event DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Cost by Chat Session

panels.description: Daily token volume for the selected member, broken into input, output, cache-read, and cache-write.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE(event_time) AS time,
  SUM(input_tokens) AS "Input",
  SUM(output_tokens) AS "Output",
  SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS "Cache Read",
  SUM(cache_write_tokens) AS "Cache Write"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'
GROUP BY DATE(event_time)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily Token Trend

panels.description: Share of total tokens that came from cache reads for the selected member in the selected period. Higher cache-read share often means lower marginal cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(
  SUM(cache_read_tokens) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens), 0),
  0
) AS "Cache Read Share"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'

panels.title: Cache Read Share

panels.description: Share of usage events with Max Mode enabled for the selected member in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(
  SUM(CASE WHEN max_mode = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
  0
) AS "Max Mode Share"
FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND connection_id = ${connection_id}
  AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
  AND IF(service_account_id <> '', CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id), user_email) = '${member}'

list.definition:
SELECT __value, __text FROM (
  SELECT email AS __value,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(name), ''), email), ' <', email, '>') AS __text,
    0 AS sort_group,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(email) = LOWER('${__user.email}') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_ord,
    name AS sort_name
  FROM _tool_cursor_members
  WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
    AND is_removed = 0
    AND email <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id) AS __value,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(service_account_name), ''), service_account_id), ' (Service Account)') AS __text,
    1 AS sort_group,
    2 AS sort_ord,
    MAX(service_account_name) AS sort_name
  FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
  WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
    AND service_account_id <> ''
  GROUP BY service_account_id
) actors
ORDER BY sort_group, sort_ord, sort_name, __text

list.query:
SELECT __value, __text FROM (
  SELECT email AS __value,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(name), ''), email), ' <', email, '>') AS __text,
    0 AS sort_group,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(email) = LOWER('${__user.email}') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_ord,
    name AS sort_name
  FROM _tool_cursor_members
  WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
    AND is_removed = 0
    AND email <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('sa:', service_account_id) AS __value,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(service_account_name), ''), service_account_id), ' (Service Account)') AS __text,
    1 AS sort_group,
    2 AS sort_ord,
    MAX(service_account_name) AS sort_name
  FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events
  WHERE connection_id = ${connection_id}
    AND scope_id = '${scope_id}'
    AND service_account_id <> ''
  GROUP BY service_account_id
) actors
ORDER BY sort_group, sort_ord, sort_name, __text
